chapter: Reel IV retellings and New York pianists
title: Willie the Lion Smith and Duke
summary: They agree the Lion had a great ego and Duke called him his mentor.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Surely. What did we say about Woodie? We didn't talk enough about Willie the Lion, I don't think.
Oh, Willie the Lion? Well, see, Willie the Lion was always like -- well, I never did come much in contact with Willie, but I knew he could play.
I had a couple clashes with him. He had a good ego, didn't he?
A great ego. But Duke seemed to be -- Duke says he's his mentor.
Oh yeah, Duke and him used to get along great, yeah.
